full_page.content:
Page 86 Nov. 8 Thanksgiv - Paul Lahey - 16 - for years had "cleptomenia" could not leve things alone - especially $ ..... cured .... "my'cle ...... Enrolled To-day
8 Leona Labadie of Wyndotte - 24 - strep-infection of some kind. Was enrolled Ser. Masses in September - was given up for time. Then re- covered quite for. some weks. - is warm again
8 Eileen Moore - 20 mo. - injured a birth - not able to hold up head or control limbs
Wm. Britton - 19 - brights disease - given possibly six months to live - parents lutherans - regret that the boy communist and refuses to believe in God.
Phyllis Bleichner - 35 - sinus Frank Schlinsk - 71 - dropsy John Pawlowicz - 13 - fits almost every week .....
Page 87
Nov. 9th Hazen Breitmeyer - 40 - Lutheran - pneumon. - one week unconscious - has wife and two .... & mother ....
Joan Croft - 10 - ostimalitis i. scull - Enrolled To-night. . . . 15th Here To-day astonishingly improving. Mother had promised perpetual Enrollments, etc.
12 V. Sr. M. Baptista - Grand Rapids - 65 - Heart trouble and blood pressure
Spec. Int. Mother anxious about girl keeping company with non Cath. - not a very religious one at that.
Mrs. Winnie Martin - 45 - Heart. ...
Carson Wills - 49 - Baptist - domestic trouble - happy at Baptism when 24 .... Wife filing for divorce
15 Mrs. Harry Bell - 1842 Sylvania Ave., Toledo - 60 - fell down stairs Febr. '36. It was feared she'd bleed to death. Worst of all had been away from Church for years. Was prayed for .... came here .... now quite improved .... cannot get out but receives regularly
